title: Journey Back to the Source
events_chronological: Marcial is born in the great house and carried up to a nursery hung with muslin.
As a small boy Marcial crawls beneath the furniture and learns the house by its undersides and its smells.
Marcial is put into his first formal clothes and taught to sit still through long meals.
As a young man Marcial gambles, drinks and keeps company with actresses in the capital.
Marcial's father dies and he inherits the title, the house and the debts together.
Marcial marries Dona Maria de las Mercedes in the cathedral.
Maria dies of a fever, and the house fills with candles, black cloth and murmuring relatives.
Marcial sells the furniture piece by piece as the creditors begin coming to the door.
Old and alone, Marcial dies in the bed he was born in while a priest administers the last rites.
The mourners go home and the shutters of the house are closed.
Workmen pull the great house down course by course while an old man with a stick watches from the gate.
Nothing is left on the site but bare ground, and the palms and the grass stand where the walls were.
syuzhet_notes: The story opens on the demolition and then runs the entire life backwards - deathbed, mourning, ruin, marriage, inheritance, youth, childhood, birth - before the last told-order bullet returns to the empty site.
fabula_notes: The reversal is presented as literally happening rather than as a way of narrating: candles grow taller, the dead sit up. The bullets record the events themselves, in the order a clock would put them.
